title: General Treatment Efficiencies of Conventional Treatment Processes

cell_spans.description: Printed header Percentage Reduction spans SS, BOD, Total Coliform

markdown:
|  | Process | SS | BOD | Total Coliform |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Primary treatment (sedimentation) | 45-60 | 30-45 | 40-60 |
| 2 | Secondary treatment |  |  |  |
|  | (i) Activated sludge plants | 85-90 | 85-95 | 90-96 |
|  | (ii) Stabilisation ponds (single cell) | 80-90 | 90-95 | 90-95 |
|  | (iii) Stabilization ponds (two cells) | 90-95 | 95-97 | 95-98 |
notes: Row (ii) is printed 'Stabilisation' and row (iii) 'Stabilization'. Both spellings preserved verbatim; not corrected.
The last header cell is printed on two lines, 'Total' over 'Coliform'; joined here as 'Total Coliform'.
Values are percentage reductions printed as ranges with a hyphen; no units are printed in the cells.
Row 2 is a group heading with no printed values; its three value cells are blank as printed.
The SS, BOD and Total Coliform columns sit under a printed spanning header 'Percentage Reduction'.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 200-600 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed page is landscape; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell/term against 144-dpi region renders and 200-dpi rotated crops; confirmed all values and printed anomalies. Corrections: added omitted spanning header Percentage Reduction and the Secondary treatment merged row
